newsitem.title: UK: Laporte details 110 mln stg subsid. sale.
newsitem.headline: Laporte details 110 mln stg subsid. sale.

text.p: Chemicals firm Laporte Plc confirmed on Friday it was selling its European adhesives and sealants operation to a subsidiary of French energy group Elf Atochem for 110 million stg.
The completion of sale is expected to take place on or before December 31.
Laporte said in a statement that the businesses being sold made a pre-exceptional operational profit of 10.6 million stg on sales of 100 million stg as on December 31, 1995.
Net assets as on that date was 32 million stg.
The sale would result in a goodwill write-off of about 50 million stg ad an exceptional gain, before expenses and tax, in the order of 28 million stg.
Jim Leng, chief executive of Laporte, said the sale was part of group's strategy to focus on speciality chemicals and performances materials.
Leng said its shift in strategy would led to reduction of its operating locations by nearly one-third.
